old_caption: The video captures a serene night scene featuring a single tree standing prominently against a starry sky. The tree is silhouetted, its branches reaching out into the darkness, creating a stark contrast with the bright stars above. Below the tree, a calm body of water reflects the tree's silhouette perfectly, mirroring the branches and trunk, adding to the tranquil atmosphere. The horizon line is clearly visible, separating the dark foreground from the lighter sky. The stars twinkle brightly, enhancing the peaceful ambiance. There are no animals or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the video, focusing on the stillness and beauty of the natural elements. The overall mood is one of quiet contemplation and natural harmony.

caption: The video captures a lone, leafless tree silhouetted on a low ridge that bisects the frame, under a star-filled sky fading from deep blue to a pale horizon glow. A calm water surface below mirrors the tree and sky in a near-symmetrical reflection. Throughout the excerpt the tree, ridge, sky, and stars hold their positions and shapes. There is no evident shift in framing. The water develops faint, slowly changing ripples and bright glints that progressively distort the mirrored image, most noticeably along the lower branches of the reflection. A small bright spot varies in position and intensity near the reflected trunk, consistent with a moving surface disturbance rather than a separate object. The reflection remains present and aligned beneath the tree, mildly deformed by surface motion that has no clear start or finish.
